kjv: this is my blood of the new testament
mine: this is My blood of the covenant
note: TR adds "kaines" ("new") from Luke 22:20/1 Cor 11:25; absent from P37, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus. KJV's "testament" for diatheke (here the covenant of Exod 24:8) also misleads modern readers.

mine: Friend, do what you (Judas) came to do
note: eph' ho parei is elliptical; most take it as a command ("[do] that for which you are here"), not a question, which would require a different construction.
